note: Used only where no direct density source exists for a Form. Every figure interpolated from a class is tagged densitySource: estimated, and every display that descends from one carries the estimate marker. A measured density from a real dataset record always wins.

spirit-40.label: Distilled spirit near 40% ABV
spirit-40.note: Alcohol is lighter than water, so a spirit sits well below 1.0.

liqueur-sweet.label: Sweetened liqueur
liqueur-sweet.note: Sugar outweighs the alcohol, so these sit above water despite the spirit content.

syrup-like.label: Sugar syrup
syrup-like.note: A 2:1 rich syrup runs higher still and should carry its own figure rather than this class.

water-like.label: Water, soda, brewed tea and coffee
water-like.note: Brewed coffee and tea are close enough to water that the difference never reaches a displayed figure.
